name: The Shadowhound learns its pet family's abilities (#267)
contract: Houndmaster's Whistle 801343 summons pet 50124 (SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PET). The client's CreatureFamily.dbc row 551 'Shadowhound' holds skill line 11805 'Pet - Shadowhound', whose SkillLineAbility rows (acquire method 2, learned with the skill) are Shadow Growl 680239 (taunt, spell level 1), Shadow Claw 800697 (up to 3 enemies, level 11), Track 500181 (leap dealing damage to up to 5 enemies, level 12) and the passive Shadowhound Visual 500036 (level 9); Scent of Magic 800528 shortens 'the Hound's next Track' through class mask B 0x400, Track's own flag. A level 20 Shadowhound therefore knows all four. The passive is the one of them a pet applies to itself on learning, so its aura on the pet observes that the family list was taught; the active abilities are taught by the same Pet::InitLevelupSpellsForLevel pass. Before the fix the pet had no family and no default spells.

steps.label: The Shadowhound has learned its family's passive
